title: Brazil Net Salary Calculator
description: Estimate Brazilian CLT net salary with INSS, IRRF, dependents, alimony, manual deductions, and a 2026 calculation memory.
metaDescription: Estimate Brazilian CLT net salary with INSS, IRRF, dependents, alimony, manual deductions, and 2026 payroll tables.

helpers.earnings: Enter monthly gross salary and separate taxable additions from non-taxable amounts paid in the paycheck.
helpers.dependents: The 2026 dependent deduction is R$189.59 per month.
helpers.manualDiscounts: Use this for transportation, meal benefits, health plan, union dues, loans, and items this calculator does not compute automatically.
helpers.legalDeductions: When enabled, applies 2026 progressive INSS and monthly IRRF. Disable it to see only gross, earnings, and manual deductions.
helpers.tableBadge: INSS/IRRF 2026 tables - official sources accessed on 2026-06-20.

validation.outrosProventosNaoTributaveis: Enter valid non-taxable earnings from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.
validation.pensaoAlimenticia: Enter valid alimony from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.
validation.descontosManuais: Enter valid manual deductions from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.
validation.adiantamentos: Enter valid advances from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.

validation.tabelaAno: This version only uses the 2026 INSS/IRRF tables.

inss.title: INSS 2026
inss.helper: The employee contribution is progressive by bands and capped at the contribution ceiling.

baseType.padrao: The standard base was lower than or equal to the simplified discount.
baseType.simplificada: The R$607.20 monthly simplified discount produced the lower base.

method.title: Calculation memory.
method.text: The estimate starts from taxable earnings, applies progressive INSS, then calculates IRRF from the standard or simplified base with the 2026 monthly reduction when applicable.
method.sourceNote: Sources accessed on {accessDate}; INSS {inssYear} and IRRF {irrfYear}, effective from January 2026.

howToCalculate.title: How to calculate net salary
howToCalculate.p1: Net salary starts from monthly gross salary plus entered earnings. Then INSS, IRRF, manual deductions, and advances are subtracted.
howToCalculate.p2: The calculator separates taxable and non-taxable earnings to show how each item affects the estimated Brazilian payslip.

inss2026.title: How INSS affects net salary in 2026
inss2026.p1: Employee INSS is progressive by bands: 7.5%, 9%, 12%, and 14%, capped at R$8,475.55 in 2026.
inss2026.p2: This estimate uses gross salary plus taxable earnings entered by the user as the base.

irrf.title: How IRRF affects the payslip
irrf.p1: IRRF uses the 2026 monthly table after INSS, dependents, deductible alimony, or the monthly simplified discount when that gives the lower base.
irrf.p2: After the monthly table, the calculator applies the 2026 monthly reduction for earnings up to R$7,350.00.

dependents.title: Dependents, alimony, and simplified discount
dependents.text: Each dependent reduces the standard base by R$189.59 per month. Deductible alimony reduces the standard base, not the simplified base.

manualDiscounts.title: Manual deductions: benefits, advances, and other items
manualDiscounts.text: Transportation, meal benefits, health plan, union dues, loans, and company-specific payroll items vary, so they are manual inputs in this first version.

officialDifference.title: Why the official payslip may differ
officialDifference.text: Official payroll may include multiple jobs, absences, variable averages, taxable rubric classification, collective agreements, court orders, eSocial, and internal rounding.

officialLinks.title: Official sources
officialLinks.intro: This version checks constants against official INSS and Receita Federal 2026 pages.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This tool is an educational monthly payroll estimate, not legal, tax, accounting, or official payroll advice. The official payslip, eSocial, employer, collective agreement, court order, and professional review prevail.

q1.question: What are gross salary and net salary?
q1.answer: Gross salary is remuneration before deductions. Net salary is the estimate after INSS, IRRF, manual deductions, and advances.

q2.question: Which INSS table does the calculator use?
q2.answer: It uses the progressive employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker table effective from January 2026.

q3.question: Which IRRF table does it use in 2026?
q3.answer: It uses the Receita Federal 2026 monthly table, dependent deduction, monthly simplified discount, and monthly reduction.

q4.question: How much do dependents reduce IRRF?
q4.answer: Each dependent reduces the standard IRRF base by R$189.59 per month in this version.

q5.question: Are transportation, meal benefits, health plan, and union dues automatic?
q5.answer: No. They vary by employer, policy, contract, and collective agreement, so enter them as manual deductions.

q6.question: Why did my official payslip differ?
q6.answer: It may include payroll rubrics, averages, absences, multiple jobs, court decisions, rounding, and setup this estimate cannot access.

q7.question: Does this work for contractors, autonomous workers, interns, or public servants?
q7.answer: No. This version estimates a Brazilian CLT monthly payslip entered by the user.

q8.question: Does it replace an accountant, payroll system, or eSocial?
q8.answer: No. It is educational and does not replace official payroll, an accountant, legal professional, Receita Federal, INSS, or eSocial.
